newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Inchon Iron and Steel hits year's high.
newsitem.headline: Inchon Iron and Steel hits year's high.

text.p: Inchon Iron and Steel Co rose to a 1997 high and Hyundai Pipe went limit up in Friday's afternoon trading on market talks the Hyundai Group would be given approval soon to build an integrated steel mill in South Korea, brokers said.
At 0530 GMT, Inchon rose 1,400 won to its upper limit of 19,800 and Hyundai Pipe added 620 won to 8,420.
But a spokesman at Hyundai Group, the nation's largest conglomerate, said he had not heard such news yet.
Hyundai had hoped to build a steel mill to meet huge steel demand from its affiliates. But the government apparently opposed Hyundai's ambition, citing an oversupply.
"The rumours also give a boost to other Hyundai shares," said Cha Hee-gun of Sunkyong Securities.
Hyundai Precision gained 800 won to 15,100 with the third largest trading volume of 1.04 million. Hyundai Engineering and Construciton added 500 won to 20,600.
